feature: Apple query dispatch respects stored representations

scenarios.name: Saved sentence vectors remain searchable when word assets appear
scenarios.given: real saved German sentence vectors and both current German word and sentence models available
scenarios.when: History reopens the unchanged index and searches the identical multiword topic
scenarios.then: the compatible actual sentence query is emitted and the saved conversation remains Related without re-embedding or changing persisted vectors

scenarios.name: Each requested current representation receives its own compatible query
scenarios.given: both German word and sentence model tags are stored
scenarios.when: History embeds a compatible multiword query
scenarios.then: both actual current model tags and normalized values are returned once in stable order; word-only behavior remains unchanged

scenarios.name: Query dispatch preserves model revision and minimum-word refusals
scenarios.given: current German word and sentence models with malformed tags, empty tag fields, and negative or unavailable positive stored revisions
scenarios.when: History requests a one-word sentence query or incompatible stored revisions
scenarios.then: the existing two-word sentence-query minimum and exact revision compatibility remain enforced without suppressing an eligible word-model query
